n = int(input())
inputStr = input().lower()
originalStr = inputStr
chars = list(inputStr)
sb = list(originalStr)
stack = []

for c in chars:
    stack.append(c)

bracketsPositions = []
for i, c in enumerate(chars):
    if c == '(' or c == ')':
        stack.pop()
        bracketsPositions.append(i)

bracketPairs = {}
for i in range(0, len(bracketsPositions), 2):
    bracketPairs[bracketsPositions[i]] = bracketsPositions[i + 1]

indicesToRemove = []
for start, end in bracketPairs.items():
    for i in range(start, end + 1):
        indicesToRemove.append(i)

removeSet = set(indicesToRemove)
filteredChars = [chars[i] for i in range(len(chars)) if i not in removeSet]
replacedChars = []

toggle = True
for i in range(len(chars)):
    if i in removeSet:
        if chars[i] in ['(', ')', '_']:
            if toggle:
                replacedChars.append(' ')
                toggle = False
        else:
            replacedChars.append(chars[i])
            toggle = True

resultStr = ''.join(replacedChars)
splitParts = resultStr.split(' ')
lengthsAfter = [len(part.strip()) for part in splitParts if len(part.strip()) != 0]

replacedStr = inputStr.replace('(', ' ').replace(')', ' ').replace('_', ' ')
originalParts = replacedStr.split(' ')
lengthsBefore = [len(part.strip()) for part in originalParts if len(part.strip()) != 0]

lengthsAfter.sort()
maxLength = lengthsAfter[-1] if len(lengthsAfter) > 0 else 0

print(f"{maxLength} {len(lengthsBefore)}")
